_meta.units: PSLE Achievement Levels (AL 1 best to AL 8), PSLE Score 4 to 32
_meta.notes: Read from the primary MOE pages, opened in full, on 2026-11-11. Each rule block carries its own source. Posting Group ranges, AL bands, the more demanding and less demanding options at the start of Sec 1 and the Higher Mother Tongue rule all match MOE word for word. Beatty's ranges are the 2025 posting; MOE publishes the 2026 cut off points in SchoolFinder in December 2026. Everything a student enters here is hypothetical and stays on the device.

postingGroups.note: Choose one group before listing schools. It applies to all six choices. If you list no schools, MOE assigns the more demanding group.
Choose one group before listing schools. It applies to all six choices. If you list no schools, MOE assigns the more demanding group.

postingGroups.needs: AL 7 or better in both English and Mathematics

noGroup: This score does not map to a Posting Group. MOE offers two options: repeat the PSLE, or move to NorthLight School or Assumption Pathway School. Talk to your primary school principal.

rules.text: AL 5 or better at Standard: you can start this subject at G3. From Posting Group 1, G2 is also an option.
AL 6 at Standard, or A at Foundation: you can start this subject at G2.

upgrades.note: These are options, so you do not have to start higher. After Sec 1 starts, a level can still go up. That depends on your results in the subject and your school's assessment.

rules.text: Taken at Foundation: you can take this subject at G2, after talking with your secondary school.
AL 6 at Standard, or A at Foundation: you can take Mother Tongue at G2.
AL 7 or 8 at Standard, or B or C at Foundation: you can take Mother Tongue at G2 or G1.
AL 7 or 8 at Standard, or B or C at Foundation: you can take Mother Tongue at G1.

downgrades.note: A less demanding start is an option at the start of Sec 1. MOE offers the Mother Tongue option to students who face exceptional difficulties coping with the language.

hmtl.text: You can take Higher Mother Tongue in Sec 1 with AL 1 or 2 in Mother Tongue. A Distinction or Merit in PSLE Higher Mother Tongue also qualifies. Schools can offer it to others too.
